expect_red: [real] a hot rail is drawn thicker and brighter than the rails beside it, and its hit path has become a visible halo

mutations.contract: The emphasis is PAINTED. A hot rail is wider and brighter than its neighbours and its transparent hit path becomes a visible halo -- which is the whole of 'bold/glow etc'.
mutations.note: Only the browser tier can see this at all: the DOM shim has no stylesheet, so every fast guard here asserts class names and would sail straight past a deleted rule. The halo selector is the one dropped because it is the part with no fallback -- lose it and the width bump is all that is left, which is what the rails looked like before this pass.
